title: 第15章 本座早已忘记先天是何低等级的存在第16章 你若修仙见我如一粒蜉蝣见青天
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 萧家大堂內。
眾人一片寂静。
萧斩依旧盯著楚风看，眉眼中的神色是越发的不悦。
以前簫火火就时常拜些骗子为师。
但是，那些骗子至少还是有模有样，还能捏的准分寸，只敢与簫火火骗些钱財，却才不敢过来萧家。
所以对於这种事情，他一般也就睁一只眼闭一只眼，也没有閒心思去多管，只要对方不会伤害到火火就行了。
结果今天这个，模样如此年轻的青年，跟簫火火都差不了几岁。
別说什么像样的装扮，身上连一点练武的气势都没有，居然就敢跟到他们萧家来了。
难道，是他们萧家提不动刀了吗？
听得萧斩有些生气语气，簫火火立即站起身，就要解释。
可却还不待他开口，坐在萧斩左侧的萧家大长老萧山，便是冷哼了一声，打断了簫火火。
萧山鬚髮皆白，已是古稀之年，可乾瘦的身子骨看起来却十分的硬朗精神。
他一双浑浊的老眼，如虎豹一般盯著楚风，眉宇间有著一丝轻蔑：
“东离城中，我萧家是城主，且有四大后天武者坐镇，其他族派拍马不及。”
“萧家少族长，身份尊贵，可不是什么人都能当他的师傅的。”
“至少，火火的师傅，实力不能弱与我们几个老骨头吧？”
“不知这位阁下，是何修为？”
萧山气势汹汹，任谁都能听得出他言语中的不善。
闻言，楚风並未开口，依旧是静静的坐著。
而其一旁的簫火火，则是站直了身子解释道：
“大长老，我师尊的修为通天彻地，凡世之人，不可想像。”
他眉头一挑，神色间有著一丝骄傲，环抱著双手道：
“也不是我瞧不起你。”
“大长老，你与我师尊，根本就没有可比性！”
话音落下，萧斩萧山几人看著簫火火骄傲的模样，又听其话语间的自信，面面相覷，都有些发懵，但同时却都有些恼火。
簫火火居然这么护著他这个师傅？
在他们的面前，还直接站在外人那边了？
还没有可比性？
大长老可是后天境界，在整个东离城都找不出多少位来。
难不成，这个簫火火带回来的青年，是先天之境？
这绝不可能！
甭说东离城，就是江南道上，都找不出来多少个先天强者，更別说这么年轻的先天强者了。
content_en:
In the lobby of the Xiao family.
There was silence.
Xiao Zhan still stared at Chu Feng, the look on his eyebrows becoming more and more unhappy.
In the past, Xiao Huohuo often worshiped liars as his teachers.
However, those scammers at least still have a decent appearance and can be very precise. They only dare to cheat Xiao Huohuo out of some money, but they don't dare to come to Xiao's house.
So for this kind of thing, he usually turns a blind eye and doesn't have the time to take care of it, as long as the other party won't hurt Huo Huo.
As a result, this young man today, who looks so young, is almost a few years older than Xiao Huohuo.
Don't put on any decent clothes, you don't even have the aura to practice martial arts, yet you dare to follow the Xiao family.
Could it be that the Xiao family is unable to move?
Hearing Xiao Zhan's somewhat angry tone, Xiao Huohuo immediately stood up and wanted to explain.
But before he could say anything, Xiao Shan, the eldest elder of the Xiao family who was sitting on the left side of Xiao Zhan, snorted coldly and interrupted Xiao Huohuo.
Xiaoshan's beard and hair are all white, and he is already seventy years old, but his skinny body looks very strong and energetic.
His turbid old eyes stared at Chu Feng like a tiger and a leopard, with a hint of contempt between his brows:
"In Dongli City, my Xiao family is the lord of the city, and there are four Houtian warriors in charge, and other clans can't keep up with us."
"The young patriarch of the Xiao family has a noble status, but not just anyone can be his master."
"At least, Huo Huo's master can't be weaker than us old bones, right?"
"I wonder what your Excellency's cultivation is?"
Xiaoshan was so angry that anyone could hear the unkindness in his words.
Hearing this, Chu Feng did not speak, but still sat quietly.
Xiao Huohuo, who was beside him, stood up straight and explained:
"Great Elder, my master's cultivation is so profound that it is unimaginable for ordinary people."
He raised his brows, with a hint of pride in his expression, crossed his hands and said:
"It's not that I look down on you."
"Great Elder, there is no comparison between you and my master!"

After the words fell, Xiao Zhan, Xiao Shan and others looked at Xiao Huohuo's proud look and listened to the confidence in his words. They looked at each other in confusion, but at the same time they were all a little annoyed.
Xiao Huohuo actually protects his master like this?
Are you still directly siding with outsiders in front of them?
No comparison yet?
The Great Elder is in the acquired realm, and there are not many of them in the entire Dongli City.
Is it possible that this young man brought back by Xiao Huohuo is in an innate state?
This is absolutely impossible!
Not to mention Dongli City, even on Jiangnan Road, there are not many innate strong people to be found, let alone such a young innate strong person.
